capabilities.name: mq.environment.status.read
capabilities.description: List queue managers visible to the connected MQ administrative endpoint and report their returned running state.

capabilities.name: mq.qmgr.status.read
capabilities.description: Read current operational status for the selected MQ queue manager.

capabilities.name: mq.qmgr.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read a bounded set of operational configuration attributes for the selected MQ queue manager.

argument_bindings.fixed_value: DISPLAY QMGR DEADQ COMMANDQ DEFXMITQ MAXHANDS MAXMSGL PLATFORM REPOS REPOSNL

capabilities.name: mq.queue.status.read
capabilities.description: Read point-in-time depth, open-handle counts, recent activity, age, and uncommitted-message status for one exact MQ local queue.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY QSTATUS({queue_name}) TYPE(QUEUE) CURDEPTH IPPROCS OPPROCS LGETDATE LGETTIME LPUTDATE LPUTTIME MSGAGE UNCOM

capabilities.name: mq.queue.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read selected capacity, access, persistence, triggering, and usage configuration for one exact MQ local queue.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY QLOCAL({queue_name}) DESCR GET PUT MAXDEPTH MAXMSGL USAGE DEFPSIST DEFSOPT BOQNAME BOTHRESH TRIGGER TRIGTYPE TRIGDEPTH PROCESS INITQ

capabilities.name: mq.channel.status.read
capabilities.description: Read current status for one exact MQ channel without starting, stopping, resetting, resolving, or pinging it.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY CHSTATUS({channel_name}) CURRENT STATUS SUBSTATE CHLTYPE CONNAME RQMNAME XMITQ INDOUBT CURMSGS MSGS LSTMSGDA LSTMSGTI

capabilities.name: mq.channel.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read the definition of one exact MQ channel without changing or testing it.

capabilities.name: mq.listener.status.read
capabilities.description: Read current status for one exact MQ listener without starting or stopping it.

capabilities.name: mq.listener.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read the definition of one exact MQ listener without changing it.

capabilities.name: mq.service.status.read
capabilities.description: Read current status for one exact MQ service on platforms that support MQ service objects.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY SVSTATUS({service_name}) STATUS PID SERVTYPE STARTDA STARTTI CONTROL

capabilities.name: mq.service.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read selected operational configuration for one exact MQ service on supported platforms.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY SERVICE({service_name}) DESCR CONTROL SERVTYPE STARTCMD STOPCMD STDOUT STDERR

capabilities.name: mq.process.configuration.read
capabilities.description: Read selected definition attributes for one exact MQ process without executing it.

argument_bindings.value_template: DISPLAY PROCESS({process_name}) DESCR APPLICID APPLTYPE USERDATA
